decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

(Reason.  To accord with the provisions of Section 92(1) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990)

Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

(Reason.  In order to safeguard the visual amenity of the area )

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

(Reason.  To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission)

Condition : 4 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

(Reason.  To protect the visual amenities of the area)

Condition : 5 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times '8 am to 11.30 pm Sunday to Thursday and 8 am to 12 midnight Fridays and Saturdays'

(Reason.  In order to safeguard the amenities of adjoining residential properties)

Condition : 6 - The use hereby permitted shall be confined to sales to customers attending the premises, and shall not extend to the delivery of food or drink to customers by vehicle.

(Reason.  In order to safeguard the amenities of adjoining residential properties)

Condition : 7 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

(Reason.  To safeguard the amenities of the area)

Condition : 8 - The use shall not commence until a scheme for control of fumes and odours including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing.

(Reason.  In order that the Local Planning Authority may be satisfied as to the arrangements for preventing loss of amenity to neighbouring premises due to fumes and smells)

Condition : 9 - The use shall not commence until a scheme for the ventilation of the premises of an appropriate outlet level, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant and the standard or dilution expected has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

(Reason.  In order that the Local Planning Authority may be satisfied as to the arrangements for preventing loss of amenity to neighbouring premises due to fumes and smells)

Condition : 10 - Before development commences details of facilities for the loading, unloading and turning of vehicles clear of the public highway shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and implemented.

(Reason.  To ensure that the proposed development does not prejudice the free flow of traffic or conditions of general safety along the adjoining highway)

Condition : 11 - The access doorway to the restaurant shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.

(Reason.  To provide satisfactory access for people with disabilities in accordance with policy;[as appropriate]

Condition : 12 - The use hereby permitted for a restaurant with take-away facility shall not be begun until details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.

Reason:  To prevent noise disturbance to nearby properties.

Condition : 13 - The use hereby permitted shall be for an A5 restaurant with a takeaway waiting area at the front of the premises, as shown on approved drawing No.197/4, and shall be used for no other purpose.Reason:  

In the interest of nearby properties living and working conditions.
description: Change of use from Office to A5 (restaurant and takeaway) incorporating single storey rear extension
